# Habbit Runner

> Habbit Runner is a server-backed habit tracker Progressive Web App (PWA) with streak analytics and push notifications.

## Product Overview

Habbit Runner helps users build and maintain daily habits through clear progress tracking and streak analytics. No app store download required — install directly from any modern browser.

## Key Features

- **Server-backed habits**: Signed-in habit data and check-ins are stored through the API.
- **Cached app shell**: The PWA caches static application resources for repeat visits; data mutations require a connection.
- **Streak tracking**: Current streak, longest streak, completion rate, and trend analytics per habit.
- **Daily routine planner**: Define daily targets, set reminders, track routines for work and personal goals.
- **Push notifications**: Web push reminders for individual habits, no native app required.
- **Google OAuth**: Secure sign-in with Google. JWT access tokens + refresh tokens.
- **PWA installable**: Install from browser on desktop and mobile. Works on Android, iOS (Safari 16.4+), and desktop Chrome/Edge.
- **Privacy-focused**: No advertising. No PII sharing with third parties. Data stays on your device first.

## Site Structure

- `/` — Main landing page with product overview and FAQ
- `/habit-tracker` — Habit tracker feature page
- `/streak-tracker` — Streak tracking feature page
- `/daily-routine-planner` — Daily routine planning feature page
- `/features` — Full feature list
- `/about` — About the product and team
- `/privacy-policy` — Privacy policy
- `/blog` — Blog with guides and technical articles
- `/vs/habitica` — Habbit Runner vs Habitica comparison
- `/vs/streaks-app` — Habbit Runner vs Streaks App comparison
- `/vs/beeminder` — Habbit Runner vs Beeminder comparison

## Technology Stack

- **Frontend**: SvelteKit 5, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Vite PWA
- **Browser-local storage**: Dexie (IndexedDB wrapper) for reminder preferences and browser-local settings
- **Backend**: Quarkus (Java), Flyway, PostgreSQL
- **Auth**: Google OAuth 2.0, JWT tokens
- **Deployment**: Docker, static PWA build

## Target Audience

People who want to build consistent daily habits with measurable progress: founders, creators, athletes, students, and professionals building daily discipline.

## Pricing

Free to use. Core habit tracking, streak monitoring, and dashboard analytics available at no cost.
